ANNUAL PERCENTAGE YIELD (APY): All APYs are accurate as of 11/28/2025.

APY is subject to change at any time without notice. Offer applies to personal non-IRA accounts only. Charges for specific services may reduce earnings. For Money Market & High Yield Savings accounts, the rate may change after the account is opened. For CD accounts, a penalty may be imposed for early withdrawals. After maturity, if your CD rolls over, you will earn the offered rate of interest for your CD type in effect at that time. See all non-IRA CD rates and terms offered here.

NATIONAL AVERAGE: National Average APYs are based on specific product types of top 50 U.S. banks (ranked by total deposits) provided by Curinos LLC through 11/03/2025. Money Market Account Rates: Average APYs are based on Money Market Accounts of $10,000. Curinos data is obtained from public sources; accuracy and completeness is not guaranteed. Curinos is not liable for reliance on the data.

FDIC INSURANCE: up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each ownership category.
